S.FORM: Misacepo' "Misacepo' "hananay no Pangcah, no Saetip a Pangcah miladis han, no Pasawali i misacepo' han, no Falangaw i mikesi' han. O sowal to " misacepo'" sanay itiniay i Fakong no Kalingko niyaro' no Makotaay sowal sa tonian, " Nano ratoh a sowal, na itiraay i Nang-yan ko Pangcah, icowaay a pala awaay to ko mafanaay, nawhani na mico'a'ang to misangaay a kawas, matefoc no kawas sa palenlen han nira a mihadefek. Deng to ya tatosaay malekakaay madipot no riyar a kawas sa mapawpaw tahira toni kanatal no Taywan, saka manga'ay to nangra itini parayray to teloc. Oni na mapawpaway milakecay a tato'asan no Pangcah, o piaray no faloco' to pidipot no riyar a kawas, saka maraod to koya paherekan talahekal a romi'ad, misalisin to toya kawas no riyar ". O roma i,.mingataay to riyar ko niyaro' no Makotaay, mikiriyaray ko 'orip no niyaro' a .tamdaw. O lalowadan to pisacepo' a demak, o pinanay ato palemed to pacefongay a mifoting ko makadofah ko pifoting a tamdaw no niyaro', ta fangcal to ko pinokay a paherek, onini i o patalahekal to 'icel no mikilotokay mikiriyaray a ma'orip a pinangan no serangawan koni, roma i o papinang to kalacecay no karikec ato kalacecay a ma'orip. I'ayaw no pacefong, polong a kapah no niyaro' masa'opo i taloan, o mato'asay no finacadan, o citanengay a tamdaw pakafana' to saiasalil a mifoting, ato pakafana' to ano tata'ak ko tapelik no riyal samanen a mifoting sanay a tanmeng. Mikapotay to pisacepo' saheto o kasaselal a tamdaw, marapot ko mato'asay, sasifo'an ato kapah, tati'ih mingata ko fafahiyan ato mikapot, i'ayaw no pisacepo'an a dadaya pacefong to a mifoting, malo sapato'aya to kawas no riyar, pakilacen ko finawlan mapolong a komaen.
S.PHON: misaʦəpo~uʡ "misaʦəpo~uʡ "ħananaj no~u paŋʦaħ, no~u saətip a paŋʦaħ miɾaɬ~ɮis ħan, no~u pasawaɾi i misaʦəpo~uʡ ħan, no~u faɾaŋaw i mikəsiʡ ħan. o~u so~uwaɾ to~u " misaʦəpo~uʡ" sanaj itiniaj i fako~uŋ no~u kaɾiŋko~u nijaro~uʡ no~u mako~utaaj so~uwaɾ sa to~unian, " nano~u rato~uħ a so~uwaɾ, na itiraaj i naŋ-jan ko~u paŋʦaħ, iʦo~uwaaj a paɾa awaaj to~u ko~u mafanaaj, nawħani na miʦo~uʡaʡaŋ to~u misaŋaaj a kawas, matəfo~uʦ no~u kawas sa paɾənɾən ħan nira a miħaɬ~ɮəfək. ɬ~ɮəŋ to~u ja tato~usaaj maɾəkakaaj maɬ~ɮipo~ut no~u rijar a kawas sa mapawpaw taħira to~uni kanataɾ no~u tajwan, saka maŋaʡaj to~u naŋra itini parajraj to~u təɾo~uʦ. o~uni na mapawpawaj miɾakəʦaj a tato~uʡasan no~u paŋʦaħ, o~u piaraj no~u faɾo~uʦo~uʡ to~u piɬ~ɮipo~ut no~u rijar a kawas, saka marao~uɬ~ɮ to~u ko~uja paħərəkan taɾaħəkaɾ a ro~umiʡaɬ~ɮ, misaɾisin to~u to~uja kawas no~u rijar ". o~u ro~uma i,.miŋataaj to~u rijar ko~u nijaro~uʡ no~u mako~utaaj, mikirijaraj ko~u ʡo~urip no~u nijaro~uʡ a .tamɬ~ɮaw. o~u ɾaɾo~uwaɬ~ɮan to~u pisaʦəpo~uʡ a ɬ~ɮəmak, o~u pinanaj ato~u paɾəməɬ~ɮ to~u paʦəfo~uŋaj a mifo~utiŋ ko~u makaɬ~ɮo~ufaħ ko~u pifo~utiŋ a tamɬ~ɮaw no~u nijaro~uʡ, ta faŋʦaɾ to~u ko~u pino~ukaj a paħərək, o~unini i o~u pataɾaħəkaɾ to~u ʡiʦəɾ no~u mikiɾo~uto~ukaj mikirijaraj a maʡo~urip a pinaŋan no~u səraŋawan ko~uni, ro~uma i o~u papinaŋ to~u kaɾaʦəʦaj no~u karikəʦ ato~u kaɾaʦəʦaj a maʡo~urip. iʡajaw no~u paʦəfo~uŋ, po~uɾo~uŋ a kapaħ no~u nijaro~uʡ masaʡo~upo~u i taɾo~uan, o~u mato~uʡasaj no~u finaʦaɬ~ɮan, o~u ʦitanəŋaj a tamɬ~ɮaw pakafanaʡ to~u saiasaɾiɾ a mifo~utiŋ, ato~u pakafanaʡ to~u ano~u tataʡak ko~u tapəɾik no~u rijaɾ samanən a mifo~utiŋ sanaj a tanməŋ. mikapo~utaj to~u pisaʦəpo~uʡ saħəto~u o~u kasasəɾaɾ a tamɬ~ɮaw, marapo~ut ko~u mato~uʡasaj, sasifo~uʡan ato~u kapaħ, tatiʡiħ miŋata ko~u fafaħijan ato~u mikapo~ut, iʡajaw no~u pisaʦəpo~uʡan a ɬ~ɮaɬ~ɮaja paʦəfo~uŋ to~u a mifo~utiŋ, maɾo~u sapato~uʡaja to~u kawas no~u rijar, pakiɾaʦən ko~u finawɾan mapo~uɾo~uŋ a ko~umaən.
